payload.text: hv, 27 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, by vc's picker. hv picked vc's recommended option in each of two questions. (1) cc's docs lean, 17 files on cc/docs1127 at 42d15bad (change 099e6e05, checked by vc): "Land, then close (Recommended)". (2) cc's audit finding, read in the code and not run: `syncz --confirm --delete` runs execute_delete, `rsync -rlptD --delete` with no `--update` or `--backup`, so it can overwrite newer destination files with older ones and keeps no .syncz-bak copy, which help/syncz.md promises: "Park it, with a warning (Recommended)". The rest is vc's wording. (1) cc makes one light Desk run of only the tests that read these docs: each utility's --help test, arngz's AT-02.1, help_dispatch.bats without AT06, and the version-literal test, with no build. cc lands the change on green, then releases. (2) The syncz fault goes, marked high, into one new unstarted thread with cc's 17 other findings (~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/docs1127-code-faults.md). A fix on main reaches hv's brew install only at the next cut, so until a release ships the fix, hv does not use `syncz --delete` on a destination that may hold newer files.
